newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slows, prices weaker, still US-bound.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slows, prices weaker, still US-bound.

text.p: NWE gasoline weakened on Tuesday, battered lower by crude's and U.S. gasoline's losses and slender local demand.
Activity was thin with most players looking for U.S. gasoline and crude futures to settle after recent losses.
"We are waiting for the API's," said one trader. Initial estimates for the data, released later today, put U.S. gasoline stocks up 2.10 million barrels.
A couple of Eurograde barges were done at $214 and $217 fob AR, but little else was heard.

An 80,000 tonne cargo of just below Eurograde spec was sold late yesterday. The cargo, believed to be heading to the U.S. on a tanker loading Feb 2-4, was done on a p&c basis. However, several traders believed the deal was concluded on a exchange futures for physical basis using March NYMEX -9/9.25 cents.
